Four things are kept apart here: investigator independence (this consortium, Stacchiotti/Maestro, Milan/Aviano, is shared with both clinical reports, so this is not EXTERNAL replication); patient/sample overlap (unestablished either way); experimental replication (the source reports independent biological replicates); and endpoint relevance (an engineered-construct effect is not a clinical response endpoint). The 40-drug screen ran on USZ20-EMC1 ALONE, verbatim: 'A medium throughput drug screen using 40 drugs was conducted with USZ20-EMC1 at passage 5.' Only carfilzomib, doxorubicin and venetoclax went on to the VALIDATION step that used both models, and it is that step -- not the 40-drug screen -- the partner-independence sentences describe. The correction does not weaken the reading: the comparison was always the validation. It is the same over-claim this repository retracted on 2026-08-06 for a different document, reappearing here.** The authors' finding is partner-INDEPENDENCE: 'Both models independent of the NR4A3 fusion partner showed high sensitivity to carfilzomib and good to moderate sensitivity to doxorubicin', and 'Similar drug responses were seen in both models, independent of the fusion partner from NR4A3.' The only partner-differential reported is a scoring-threshold one: the carfilzomib + venetoclax and carfilzomib + doxorubicin combinations scored synergistic (ZIP/Loewe/Bliss/HSA) in the EWSR1 model and additive in the TAF15 model, with one model per arm and no statistical claim. ⛔ *WITHDRAWN OUTRIGHT 2026-09-08 (residual batch R7), retained as superseded: 'NEITHER MODEL WAS TESTED AGAINST AN ANTIANGIOGENIC TKI'.* THE 40-COMPOUND INVENTORY IS REFERRED TO A FIGURE NOT RETAINED HERE, so that blanket exclusion cannot be checked and is not asserted. So this work cannot confirm or refute the clinical correlation. ⛔ *WITHDRAWN, retained as superseded: 'the authors' finding is partner-INDEPENDENCE ... there is no evidence that the partner predicts response to drug classes in general'* AS A GENERAL INFERENCE. Similar responses in two unmatched patient-derived models to three named agents bound the observation; they do not establish partner independence of drug response in general, and two different patients' models cannot supply that test.

separate_descriptive_context_not_pooled._why: These series bear on the same question and are reported at their own scope, with their own endpoints, rather than merged. None of them is pooled, and none is presented as confirming or refuting the cohort above.
separate_descriptive_context_not_pooled.huang-2023: Abstract-supported only. It reports 58 FISH-confirmed EMC with 46 EWSR1, 9 TAF15, 2 TCF12 and 1 unidentified partner; that TAF15::NR4A3 was significantly associated with size >10 cm (78%, P = .025); that size >10 cm, nuclear pleomorphism, metastasis at presentation, TAF15::NR4A3 and chemotherapy administration each portended shorter univariate disease-specific survival; and that only size >10 cm (P = .004) and metastasis at presentation (P = .032) remained prognostically independent. ⛔ THAT THE PARTNER TERM DID NOT REMAIN CONVENTIONALLY SIGNIFICANT DOES NOT ESTABLISH THAT AN INDEPENDENT ASSOCIATION IS ABSENT, that any crude association is confounded, or that tumour size explains the partner. ⚠ AND THE TWO STATEMENTS ARE KEPT SEPARATE (2026-09-08, R3): the abstract DOES report TAF15::NR4A3 among the factors associated with shorter UNIVARIATE disease-specific survival, and separately reports that it was not among the two factors remaining independent in the MULTIVARIABLE model. Collapsing those into 'the partner was not associated with survival' misreports the source. No coefficient, interval, event count or model specification is available in any retained source. ⛔ *Superseded, retained: 'the event count implied by a series this size makes model instability a live concern'.* THE EVENT COUNT CANNOT BE INFERRED FROM n. Small cohorts and several candidate predictors warrant a cautious concern about model stability, but model adequacy, precision and overfitting CANNOT BE ASSESSED without the actual event count and specification, and none is available. Size may itself lie on a fusion-driven causal path rather than outside it. The words 'defeater', 'confounded' and 'absorbed' are withdrawn from this synthesis.
separate_descriptive_context_not_pooled.paioli-2021: Abstract-supported only: 67 localised patients, 50 EWSR1 / 10 TAF15 / 1 TCF12 / 1 TFG, median follow-up 55 months, partner trends for DFS p = 0.08 and DMFS p = 0.09, tumour size p = 0.004 for DMFS. ⛔ The abstract does not state an adjustment structure, so this is NOT a second adjusted test, and its size p-value concerns DISTANT METASTASIS-FREE SURVIVAL -- a different endpoint from Huang's disease-specific survival. primary_authors_hedge.reading: The investigators who reported the correlation read it as a SURROGATE for something downstream. ⛔ THAT WAS THEIR READING AS OF 2012. ⛔ CORRECTED 2026-09-08: THIS IS A DATED SEQUENCE OF PUBLISHED HYPOTHESES, NOT A STATEMENT OF WHAT THE INVESTIGATORS NOW BELIEVE. The same group's Brenca 2019 discussion proposes that the fusion-dependent axon-guidance changes MAY AFFECT receptor signalling and sunitinib response -- a later, fusion-mediated hypothesis that directly qualifies the 2012 prior. An effect acting through a downstream pathway is still a fusion-mediated mechanism; a drug need not bind the fusion protein for the fusion to influence response, so 'surrogate for something downstream' and 'fusion mechanism' are not opposites. Three later observations belong beside the 2012 prior at their own scope: Huang 2023's reported multivariable analysis, in which the partner term did not remain conventionally significant; Paioli 2021, which reaches only trends on the partner; and Bangerter 2022's two patient-derived models, in which three validated agents produced similar responses. None of the three establishes absence of a fusion-mediated mechanism.
